title: Quality, Safety, and Analytics
summary: Measure design, registries, dashboards, population health, and the statistical literacy traps the boards quietly test. How to read a quality measure spec, how to critique a dashboard, and how to tell a real signal from a denominator artifact.
learningOutcomes: Read a CMS or NQF measure specification and identify numerator, denominator, and exclusions.
Critique a quality dashboard for both statistical validity and frontline usability.
Distinguish process measures, outcome measures, and balancing measures with clinical examples.
Recognize common analytic traps: regression to the mean, Simpson's paradox, denominator drift.
Explain the difference between a registry and a data warehouse and when you'd build each.
